views.title: Code with Grok in Your Terminal

views.markdown:
Run `grok` in a terminal to ask for code changes, work with your files, and run project commands. Sign in through your browser or use an xAI API key.

## Compatibility

Requires iOS 15 or later and a jailbroken device with a shell. Choose `iphoneos-arm64e` for roothide or `iphoneos-arm64` for rootless; both packages contain the same arm64 executable.

Updates are installed through your package manager. Desktop bundled skills and CPU profiling are unavailable on iOS. Clipboard copying uses OSC 52 and requires a compatible terminal.

[View Source](https://github.com/owngoal-dev/grok)
